claims.statement: For a selected committed Python file and top-level symbol, an agent can obtain a bounded verification plan that composes authored verification records, direct test-function candidates and guard-derived scenario candidates into a deduplicated pytest candidate set with explicit gaps, without executing tests or claiming coverage.

attributes.title: Change-scoped verification plan from direct references

origin.author: Sensemaking construction agent under the 2026-11-28 delegated mission

alignment.basis: ADR 0031 retains source-grounded knowledge for later engineering use; the plan is a consumer that turns existing verification evidence into a candidate test set, leaving the agent to judge and execute.

ambition.basis: A bounded composition of existing direct-reference, verification-record and guard-scenario surfaces, not a new runtime, coverage system or test generator.

horizon.basis: The 2026-11-25 symbol context already returns direct test-function candidates and guard scenarios; the authored knowledge query already returns verification records. The missing piece is a plan consumer.

realization.basis: The 2026-11-25 normal-use record states that a consumer had to inspect test bodies manually to expand a verification plan for build_knowledge_snapshot. No plan consumer or deduplicated candidate command exists.

disposition_history.authority: agent-authored synthesis under current delegated mission
disposition_history.rationale: Combines the existing symbol context, authored verification records and guard-derived scenario candidates into a change-scoped verification plan. It addresses the recorded manual verification-plan work without generating tests, executing them or inferring coverage.

attributes.synthesis_basis: Combines the existing symbol context, authored verification records and guard-derived scenario candidates into a change-scoped verification plan. It addresses the recorded manual verification-plan work without generating tests, executing them or inferring coverage.
attributes.value_hypothesis: A change-scoped verification plan reduces manual test-body inspection and missed verification by turning direct references, authored verification records and guard scenarios into a runnable candidate set with explicit gaps.
attributes.revisit_when: An independent agent uses the plan on a real change and records whether it changed the verification set; or the direct test-candidate scope or authored verification record surface changes.
attributes.counterevidence: Direct mentions are not coverage and may miss helpers, fixtures, parameterized work and runtime paths. Authored verification records are file-level. Guard scenarios are candidates, not tests. The plan may over-include tests and does not establish sufficiency or pass status.
attributes.claim_ceiling: One plan consumer and one real-symbol exercise. It does not establish coverage, test sufficiency, a changed verification decision, independent reuse, comparative benefit or longitudinal development.
